description:
Larson Ridge cabin is managed and maintained by the Mount Remo Backcountry Society (MRBS) under an agreement with Recreation Sites and Trails B.C. The cabin is primarily used for backcountry skiing but the area also offers outstanding alpine hiking opportunities. There are no developed trails on Larson Ridge so good outdoor and route finding skills are essential.

Contact MRBS at info@mtremo.ca for additional information.
directions: Access to the Larson Ridge is by helicopter only. Helicopter charters can be arranged locally.
